sections.title: The word for the whole thing
sections.content: beosztás is the ordinary word for a schedule or arrangement — időbeosztás ("time" + "schedule") is the same idea, slightly more formal. heti is the adjective form of hét: "weekly". Together, heti beosztás is exactly "weekly schedule" — the thing you've been building all lesson.

items.english: Every day my schedule is different.

sections.content: -i turns a noun into an adjective here (hét -> heti, "week" -> "weekly") — the same small pattern behind napi ("daily"), heti ("weekly"), and havi ("monthly") that you'll keep running into.
